sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This is a strong fixture for the leaders, as Alsager are bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games and have won only once all season. Sandbach will be looking to bounce back from their most recent loss, having won four of their previous five matches.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town (20 points) host Dawley Town on Saturday, seeking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent defeat. In the title race, AFC Bridgnorth (19 points) travel to Eccleshall (18 points) in a fixture between two strong sides, though both have lost their most recent match. Wolverhampton Casuals (19 points), riding a three-game winning run, face Wednesfield Community (13 points) at home, before meeting Brereton Social away on Wednesday evening—a busy midweek schedule. Bilston Town (17 points) host improving Foley Meir (11 points) as the visitors attempt to climb from mid-table, while Barnton (15 points) entertain Shawbury United (10 points), who are in poor form with five straight defeats. New Mills (14 points) travel to Market Drayton Town (12 points) in a fixture between struggling sides, Crewe (9 points) host Allscott Heath (11 points), and Cheadle Heath Nomads (7 points) visit Telford Town (6 points)—both in the bottom half. Brereton Social (11 points) host struggling Widnes Town (2 points) on Saturday, before their Wednesday trip to Wednesfield Community.
